title: Dani's Office site config
description: Curation layer driving the live portfolio: one ordered list of named sections, each with a layout. Every video id must exist in data/library.json. Edited via the visual editor (editor.html), consumed by scripts/sync_from_sheet.py which resolves it into js/projects.js for the front end. Version 1 (separate `featured` + `sections`) is migrated automatically.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last edit. Set by the editor; cosmetic.

sections.description: Sections in page order. Each also becomes a tab on the phone. Empty sections are kept but not rendered.

id.description: Slug used for the DOM id and the phone tab. Stable; the title is what people see.

title.description: Header text on the site and tab label on the phone. Free text.

layout.description: hero: rows of one optional long-form with a row of shorts beside it (or a full-width row of shorts with no long-form). wide: 16:9 grid of long-forms. tall: 9:16 grid of shorts.

video_ids.description: wide / tall layouts: video ids in display order.

groups.description: hero layout: rows in display order. A row lays itself out by counting its long-forms: none = a row of shorts, one = the big tile with the shorts beside it, two or more = the long-forms on top with the shorts beneath.

label.description: Row header. Empty = the first long-form's channel name, or the section title when the row has no long-form.

shorts_label.description: Label above the shorts of a row that also has long-forms. Empty = "Related shorts".

video_ids.description: Video ids in the row, both shapes, in display order.
